title: journey_ended payload, pv 1 (PROPOSED, docs/VUKA-2-SPEC.md §4b)
description: Committed private payload of a journey_ended event. Deliberately carries no `mode` and no authorisation reference: the PIN authority is the separate pin_authorised event for action end_journey, matched by §9's exact-action-and-target rule. That keeps a duress end and a normal end byte-identical in shape (T52, T15 harness). Numeric fields are integers (spec §5). Adding a field is a pv bump.

journey_id.description: The journey being ended; must equal the target_id of the fresh end_journey pin_authorised (§9).
